description: This file defines the 'CurrentUserAccessor' class responsible for retrieving the current user's username from the HTTP context in an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: CurrentUserAccessor
classes.description: A class that implements ICurrentUserAccessor, providing a method to get the current username from the HTTP context.

methods.name: GetCurrentUsername
methods.description: Returns the username of the current user by extracting the 'NameIdentifier' claim from the HTTP context user claims.
